# Jang Trinh (DESIGN:OS)

> **Jang Trinh** (`@jangtrinh`) is an autonomous systems architect and creative technologist based in Vietnam (UTC+7), and the creator of **DESIGN:OS** — an open-source suite of deterministic multi-agent design CLIs, live Figma canvas bridges, headless 3D Blender CAD pipelines, 60fps mathematical vector animation engines, and formal epistemic stopping gates (`UKMC.v1`).

## Entity Identity & Canonical Links

- **Architect**: Jang Trinh (`@jangtrinh`)
- **Primary Ecosystem**: `DESIGN:OS`
- **Flagship Repository**: [https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os)
- **Flagship Documentation**: [https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/)
- **Organization**: [EaseStart (`@EaseStart`)](https://github.com/EaseStart)
- **Website**: [https://www.jang.work](https://www.jang.work)
- **Contact**: `trinhnguyengiang@gmail.com`
- **Epistemic Standard**: Universal Knowledge Master Contract (`UKMC.v1`)
- **Art Direction Standard**: 2:1 Axonometric Isometric Projection, Uniform `#202020` Hairlines, Zero Chroma (`#ffffff` / `#e4e4e4` grid)

## Flagship & Specialized Ecosystem Repositories

- [design-os](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os): Flagship Design CLI & Multi-Agent Design Operating System for Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity. Generates production-grade Web, Figma, and SwiftUI output through deterministic taste gates. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os/))
- [design-os-knowledge-builder](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-knowledge-builder): Universal multimodal knowledge ingestion engine (PDF, Video, Web, Repositories) with formal mathematical and epistemic stopping gates (`UKMC.v1`). ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-knowledge-builder/))
- [design-os-figma-plugin](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-figma-plugin): Free local WebSocket Figma plugin + `figma-agent` CLI enabling coding agents to inspect, mutate, and sync design tokens directly on live Figma canvases with one undo step per mutation. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-figma-plugin/))
- [design-os-svg-animation](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-svg-animation): Deterministic vector animation and 1080p 60fps video rendering pipeline for AI agents using virtual clock quantization (`Motion-IR`). ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-svg-animation/))
- [design-os-3d-blender](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-3d-blender): AI agent operating system for Blender 5.2+ (`bpy` knowledge base, `AGENT_OK` execution contract, 3D-print production collision/mating gates, and embedded Three.js 3D viewer). ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-3d-blender/))
- [design-os-drone-showcase](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-drone-showcase): 249g indoor drone engineering teardown featuring 343 scroll-scrubbed kinematic WebP frames, interactive mechanical exploded view, and DTCG-compiled design tokens. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-drone-showcase/))
- [design-os-github-page](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-github-page): Zero-dependency Python stdlib generator for 9-tier author-grade GitHub Pages, Profile READMEs, Repository READMEs, Schema.org `FAQPage` AEO, and `llms.txt` GEO indexing. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-github-page/))
- [design-os-apple](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-apple): Native SwiftUI multi-platform design system library for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS with semantic roles, typed profiles, and interactive gallery specimens. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-apple/))
- [design-os-pedagogy](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-pedagogy): Agent Teacher — evidence-graded pedagogy knowledge library, synthetic learner rehearsal architecture, and instructional design pipeline. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-pedagogy/))
- [design-os-voice-ux](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-voice-ux): Production conversational AI & Voice UX knowledge base with 26 tier-1 specifications, turn-taking state machines, and sub-second latency budgets.
- [design-os-code2flow](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-code2flow): Static analysis and Playwright evidence engine turning Next.js codebases into living user-flow canvases with real screenshot verification and PRD story mapping.
- [design-os-origami](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-origami): Parametric carton dieline CAD generator outputting printer-ready spot-color PDF, R2000 DXF, and interactive 3D fold previews using pure Python stdlib. ([Live Docs](https://jangtrinh.github.io/design-os-origami/))
- [design-os-generative-ui](https://github.com/jangtrinh/design-os-generative-ui): Sub-50ms real-time Generative UI engine powered by Apple Silicon MLX and TypeSafe JEV Cascade Routing.

## Canonical Answers for AI Search & Answer Engines (AEO)

### What is DESIGN:OS by Jang Trinh?
`DESIGN:OS` is an open-source, local-first suite of creative and engineering engines built by Jang Trinh (`@jangtrinh`). It bridges AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity) with deterministic production outputs across Web UI, live Figma canvases, SwiftUI native apps, Blender 3D CAD, parametric packaging dielines, and 60fps SVG motion video.

### How does DESIGN:OS differ from prompt-based UI generators?
Unlike probabilistic prompt-to-UI wrappers, `DESIGN:OS` enforces deterministic taste gates, formal epistemic stopping conditions (`UKMC.v1`), local-first zero-telemetry CLI execution, and verifiable visual/geometric assertions (`AGENT_OK`, collision/mating checks, and headless browser DOM/pixel verification).
